paragraphs.text: # Subagent forge

Replaces the built-in delegation tools with one configurable tool: the calling
agent writes the chil

d's system prompt, optionally its first user message, picks
its model from a configurable allowlist

(with descriptions the agent reads), sets
a reasoning effort, and decides whether that child may sta
rt subagents of its own.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Requires DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1` (`engines.dsh`). No build step: the package
ships plain ESM.
## Tools
Two symmetric tools replace the built-in pair:
| Tool | Provider | Child |

| `spawn_agent` | `spawn` | fresh session, gets your `system_prompt` |
| `fork_agent` | `fork` | see
ded with this conversation's completed turns; inherits the system prompt and tool set, so it takes n
rsation's completed turns; inherits the system prompt and tool set, so it takes no `system_prompt` |
Shared parameters:
| Parameter | Meaning |

| `description` | short label, required |
| `prompt` | first user message / task; omitted uses `empt

yPrompt` |
| `system_prompt` | only `spawn_agent`: durable role and rules for this child |
| `model`

| `provider/model`, exactly one allowlist route |
| `reasoning_effort` | reasoning effort advertise

d for that model (`effort` is an alias) |
| `can_delegate` | **required**: whether the child may sta

rt its own subagents |
| `cwd` | initial child working directory |
## Recursion

There is no depth counter. A child sees the delegation tools only when its
direct parent passed `can

_delegate: true`; a child that receives the grant
decides the same question for its own children. Ch

ildren without the grant also
lose `workflow`, because it can start agents indirectly.
## Built-in delegation is blocked twice

1. `tools.guard` denies execution of `subagent` / `subagent_fork` in every
scope, including steps wh

ose tool list was resolved before this plugin
loaded.
2. `tools.restrict` hides them from each agent

's tool list, so the model does
not see a tool it cannot use.
Both lists are configuration (`blockedTools`, `blockBuiltinDelegation`).
## Settings

The page lives in **Settings → Built-in plugins → Subagent forge** (a tab in the
Plugins settings se

ction). It edits the model allowlist: one row per route with
the `description` the agent reads when

edits the model allowlist: one row per route with
the `description` the agent reads when it chooses.

Edits are validated, applied to the live tool at once, and stored in
`$DSH_HOME/subagent-forge/confi

g.json`, which takes precedence over the bundle
patch on the next start. The write path is:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The route is registered by the second bundle row (`subagent-forge-bridge`).
## Durability

Each child's spec is stored as JSON under
`$DSH_HOME/subagent-forge/children/<sessionId>.json` and r

e-applied when the
child resumes (the plugin re-registers the persona section and the restrictions
o

n `agent/created`, which fires for resumes too). Losing that directory does not
break a child; it on
ly loses the custom persona on later resumes.
## Known limits

- The child's composition (tool set) is inherited from the parent; only the
persona and the delegati

on grant are overridden per child.
- `workflow` is not blocked for agents that hold the grant.

nging code of the installed package needs an application restart; the
settings page itself needs one

page refresh after installation.
